notes: E-mail when you activate a key. The licence window now has an e-mail field for the key, too. It is needed when we do not have an e-mail for your key yet (for example a key bought on plati.ru); it is saved with your key, and the Lost your key? page can give the key back with it. The [privacy policy](https://ssm-audio.github.io/Best-Trigger-3/privacy.html) says what we keep.
